title: DVB-T2 typestate builder preset for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Typestate fluent builder API for the DVB-T2 BICM AWGN preset.
Compile-time check on stage ordering; method-chaining ergonomics.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation for gf2-sim
pipeline) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] DVB-T2 BICM chain expressible via the typestate
  builder; wrong stage ordering yields a compile-time error
  diagnosable via `cargo check`.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
